CustomObject.description: For directing Cases using Skill Based Routing, this metadata maps from a Case Queue (identified using developer name) to a Market-Channel Skill. This metadata is referenced in the "SC - Case - Before" flow. If no mapping is found for a new Case Queue owner, GB Cases is applied by default.
CustomObject.label: SCV Case Queue To Market-Channel Map
CustomObject.pluralLabel: SCV Case Queue To Market-Channel Maps
